prediction_boundary.variable: optional predicted transformed byte for arm A at original transformed coordinate i
prediction_boundary.source_location: sealed Scanner::Observe before x_i is appended to event state or used for table/stack mutation
prediction_boundary.before: only decoded prefix state, an already decoded L or L/slash opener, prior retained stack/table records, and causal ordinals are available
prediction_boundary.after: D/R/S/N predictions are scored on identical D-active positions, then x_i may update parser, stack, table, counters, and digests

update.equation: Before transformed truth x_i mutates state, derive optional closing replay C from an already decoded L/slash prefix and retained stack top, derive optional transition replay T from an already decoded L and a unanimously learned prior completed-event record, and select D as T with overlap priority otherwise C. On every and only D-active position construct R from frozen SplitMix64 causal ordinals, S by a one-byte cyclic rotation of the complete selected D target, and N as D xor 0xff; freeze and score all outputs against x_i. Only afterward append x_i, update quotes and event completion, apply table and stack transitions, and advance counters and digests. K executes the identical parser, lookup, opportunity, table, stack, and digest transitions with structural prediction disabled; P has no structural state.

lifecycle.activate: T can activate only after L is decoded; C only after L/slash is decoded; D/R/S/N share the resulting D-active coordinate
lifecycle.reset: clear only the bounded current-event buffer and quote/overflow flags at event termination; retained stack, previous-event records, transition table, and digests persist

numeric_contract.format: unsigned modulo-2^64 FNV-1a and SplitMix64, fixed-width integer counters, byte-exact targets, and no floating-point arithmetic
numeric_contract.rounding: not applicable; integer overflow follows the sealed unsigned modulo semantics
numeric_contract.overflow: name, event, or stack overflow suppresses predictions according to the sealed parser and cannot expose truncated state
numeric_contract.accumulation_order: absolute transformed coordinate, T-before-C overlap priority, arm order C/T/D/R/S/N, then post-truth parser/table/stack source order

arms.definition: Qualified q1 parent with no WIKI-PDA structural state or shadow prediction; conceptual comparator only at this opportunity gate.
Execute the exact D parser, lookup, opportunity construction, table learning, stack mutation, counters, and digests with structural prediction disabled.
After decoded L/slash, replay the retained top-of-stack closing name and terminal N from relative offset two onward.
After decoded L, replay the unanimously learned prior completed-event signature from relative offset one onward.
Aligned union of T and C on causal positions with T taking overlap priority.
Frozen SplitMix64 byte from event key, absolute position, and source selector on every and only D-active coordinate.
One-byte cyclic rotation of the complete already available selected D target on the identical D-active coordinate.
Bitwise byte complement D xor 0xff on every and only D-active coordinate.

ceilings.reject_only_futility_rule: Retire the exact structural information source only after two complete valid scans prove D.active below 254,953 or a frozen chronological control, causality, repeat, or measured resource predicate fails; complete-byte correctness is diagnostic only and passing earns no archive authority.
